svg.text: E10.27 — the model and the page: what is new on each side
A placeholder stays an ordinary object whose anchor has a purpose. Nothing in the document format changes: no new field, no new kind of object.
# each returns a Batch; settle repairs copies
A text placeholder's hint is its own words (the slide's copy starts empty, so only the layout shows it). A picture placeholder is an image object without an asset;
its hint is a fixed word by kind, so the panel has no hint field for it. This keeps the format as it is and makes Make placeholder on a text box change one thing: its purpose.
